description: This file provides utility functions and classes for verifying and handling JWT tokens issued by Supabase, including fetching JWKS, caching, extracting 'kid', and verifying token claims. It also includes a FastAPI dependency for retrieving the current user based on the JWT in the Authorization header.

methods.name: get_supabase_url
methods.description: Returns the Supabase project URL from environment variables, raising an error if not set.

methods.name: _jwks_url
methods.description: Constructs the URL to fetch JWKS from Supabase based on the project URL.

methods.name: _get_cached_jwks
methods.description: Retrieves cached JWKS data if available and not expired.

methods.name: _set_cached_jwks
methods.description: Caches JWKS data with a TTL.

methods.name: _fetch_jwks
methods.description: Fetches JWKS from Supabase and caches it, handling errors and format validation.

methods.name: _get_kid
methods.description: Extracts the 'kid' from a JWT header without verifying the token.

methods.name: _find_jwk_for_kid
methods.description: Finds the JWK in the JWKS matching the provided 'kid'.

methods.name: _expected_issuers
methods.description: Returns a list of valid issuer URLs for Supabase tokens.

methods.name: verify_jwt
methods.description: Verifies a JWT token's signature and claims, including issuer and expiration, returning the decoded claims if valid.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that extracts and verifies the JWT from the Authorization header, returning user claims.
